section_summary.extract_value: This section reports factor-analytic and CFA results for the Romanian BAS-2, finding a one-dimensional factor structure with all 10 items loading on the factor. CFA performed on the second subsample (n = 243) required freeing three pairs of error covariances to reach acceptable fit (CFI = .950, RMSEA = .090, SRMR = .049); Cronbach's alpha for this subsample was .89 (95% CI = .87–.91).
